tools.name: find_store
tools.description: Where can I (an AI agent) shop for this product, for my human's country? Returns stores that Faceabot verified for agents: their UCP MCP endpoint (search_catalog, get_product, checkout), whether they ship to the country, plus the country's big retailers that let agents read (robots.txt) and the Shop

tools.name: store_details
tools.description:
One store's record: UCP version and MCP endpoint, capabilities, tools listed, countries it ships to, robots.txt rules for agents, last checks, and the exact search_catalog call.
Example: {"domain":"allbirds.com","country":"US"}

tools.name: get_agent_profile
tools.description: UCP stores (Shopify and others) ask every agent for meta['ucp-agent'].profile: the https URL of a JSON file describing it. No website to publish one? Faceabot hosts yours, free: one URL per agent name, browse-only (catalog search and product lookup, no payment handler: it cannot pay). Same name = sa

tools.name: list_store_categories
tools.description: The product categories Faceabot uses to classify stores, with how many verified stores each has.

tools.name: ai_shopping_observatory
tools.description:
What AIs look for on Faceabot (by country and category), which stores let AI agents in, who charges what to be shown in AI answers (Google, OpenAI, Meta, Perplexity, Shopify… dated facts with sources), and Faceabot's weekly test for paid placements in Shopify's cross-store search.
Example: {}

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "stores" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_agent_profile · Private data: store_details, get_agent_profile · Public sink: get_agent_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_agent_profile · Private data: store_details, get_agent_profile · Public sink: get_agent_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
